label: <DEL> step of long sequences (L>=7)
explanation: Fires almost only on the <DEL> delimiter step (92% of activation mass, 11.6% of delimiter steps), and much more often when the sequence is long: rate at the delimiter climbs steeply with L (to_go=8 i.e. L=9 is ~15% of all steps there, L<=5 almost never). Magnitude also grows with L; the top activations are L=8-9 delimiters. Only about 30% of L=9 delimiters fire, and which ones fire depends on content in a diffuse way (weak preference for sequences containing h/g/u/i/r/2/3, or starting with j/i/v/a/o/c). Content predicates I tried gave little improvement. Weak secondary activity: the last original token (often h, r, 2) just before <DEL>, and the first copy output step, both small. Essentially silent during the early original phase (t<5) and rare in the copy phase.
